parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

parameters.name: TrRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the transit router.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the region information corresponding to a region ID.
